summary: This clinical trial tested treatments for adults with hypercholesterolemia, a condition involving high levels of cholesterol in the blood. The study compared the drug enlicitide against other medications like ezetimibe and bempedoic acid. Sponsored by Merck Sharp & Dohme LLC, the trial has a status of Completed and included 301 participants. This Phase 3 study looked at changes in low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, which is often called bad cholesterol.
